notes.title: ASU 0.500.01.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello all!

A slightly delayed hotfix for a couple of issues surrounding the [b]Mist Swallower[/b] boss.

-Fixed an issue with ranged attacks caused by an incosistency in the hit box
-Fixed an issue where the teleporter after defeating the boss wasn't activiating

notes.title: ASU 0.500.01.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Quick hotfix for a couple issues that were found about... thirty seconds after the last build was posted. 


-Fixed [b]Koskan Saltwater[/b] being chosen when clicking on [b]Willow[/b]

-Fixed the [b]Mist Swallower[/b] not spawning properly when reaching its arena

notes.title: ASU 0.450.03.01 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello all!

A quick hotfix to fix unlock issues with a few achievements. Namely the: Dorga, Mote Colony, and Starward Softshell. 

Along with that, there's a fix for both [b]Aisla[/b]'s and [b]Marble[/b]'s scarification altar unlocks not working properly.


Thank you all,
Until next time,
Lucas

notes.title: 0.400.02.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Turns out I accidentally pushed out an internal build onto the defaul branch! And, of course, it would happen on the day that I am away from my computer for 10 hours afterwards! Fun times. >.>

Anywho, it is now fixed and the proper build has been uploaded.



Thank you all,
Until next time,
Lucas

notes.title: ASU 0.350.01 Hotfix 3
notes.notes:
Welp, another quick update. Seems there have been a few big things that have been wrong today. 


-Fixed [b]Stephan[/b]'s incorrect icons

-Fixed a bug where the [b]Shroomery[/b] building was being fed the incorrect building level

-Optimized the behavior of the building upgrades widget

notes.title: ASU 0.350.01 Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
Hello all! 

Just a quick hotfix!

-normalized the spawn rate of all possible random spawns in dungeons 

-fixed an issue where Very Hard **Saren Glass** wasn't spawning properly

notes.title: A Storm Unsung: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Hello all!

We are proud to announce that as of now, A Storm Unsung has released into Early Access!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963883/6c67bff7cddc4b81f15822c824a7cc6d938cceda.png[/img]

We are looking forward to working with you all to make ASU the best that it can be! I thank you for sticking with us to this point and look forward to the future. I hope you all enjoy your time with ASU!


Until then,
Thank you all,
Lucas

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/x9ArrpkcgE]Discord![/url]

notes.title: A Storm Unsung: Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hello all!

As of, well, approximately 30 minute ago, we have a demo available to try! You can find it from the normal places one would expect - ASU's steam page and also from searching specifically for it.

As a double-whammy kind of deal, I have added our official Discord server to the sidebar on the store page as well. And I'll begin linking it in each announcement, in case anyone can't find it anywhere else. 


Join our [url=https://discord.gg/8Z9HJFzt]Discord![/url]

As always,
Until next time,
Thank you for you time,
Lucas
